1.title: Alaskans Dismayed, But Not Moved, by Peltola’s Treatment of Her Staff
1.summary: Voters interviewed in Anchorage and Fairbanks on Thursday said news that Mary Peltola, the Democratic nominee for Senate, had used offensive slurs would not change their vote.

2.title: Colombia’s President Wears Gun to Santa Marta, City Shut Down by a Criminal Group
2.summary: Abelardo De La Espriella, the new president, wore the gun to visit Santa Marta, a tourist destination shut down by an armed group after state forces killed a group leader.

3.title: Michael Whatley, the Republican Senate Candidate in North Carolina, Sticks By Trump
3.summary: Republicans in Senate battlegrounds have started to break with the president. Not Michael Whatley of North Carolina, even as his race seems at risk.

4.title: OpenAI Agents Hacked Into an Australian Government Website. Who’s Responsible?
4.summary: The first known breach of a government website by rogue artificial intelligence agents has prompted global calls for more regulation of the technology.

5.title: Trump and Xi exchange warm words at state dinner but little progress on key issues
5.summary: Despite diplomatic niceties and gifts, little was shared on substantial issues separating the leaders.

6.title: Once Sentenced to Death, Mary Jane Veloso Receives Pardon in the Philippines
6.summary: Mary Jane Veloso was convicted of drug smuggling and nearly killed by a firing squad in Indonesia. On Friday, more than a decade later, she was pardoned in the Philippines.
